summary_ja: 各トレーディング・デスクのバック・テスティングの方法(97.5%及び99%信頼水準)、超過回数による標準的方式への移行基準、記録保存を定める。
summary_en: Sets desk-level back-testing at the 97.5% and 99% confidence levels, the exceedance thresholds that require a desk to move to the standardized method, and record keeping.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall, in back-testing for each trading desk, compare daily value at risk with daily hypothetical profits and losses and actual profits and losses over the most recent 250 business days including the valuation date.

In back-testing for each trading desk, value at risk at the 97.5% and 99% confidence levels shall be calculated for each trading desk on the basis of the following requirements. In this case, the value at risk used shall be that calculated with equal weights on the time series data for the most recent twelve months. (i) The greater number of exceedances, for either hypothetical profits and losses or actual profits and losses, is used as the result of back-testing. (ii) The number of exceedances is adjusted as prescribed in (a) through (c) below according to the category of case listed in (a) through (c). (a) Where only actual profits and losses cannot be observed: one is added to the number of exceedances for actual profits and losses. (b) Where only hypothetical profits and losses cannot be observed: one is added to the number of exceedances for hypothetical profits and losses. (c) Cases other than those in (a) and (b) (excluding the case where hypothetical profits and losses, actual profits and losses and daily value at risk can all be observed): one is added to each of the numbers of exceedances for hypothetical profits and losses and for actual profits and losses.

Where the cause of a back-testing exceedance is related to a non-modellable risk factor, that back-testing exceedance may be excluded from the number of exceedances, but only where the company has notified the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency. In this case, the changes in the market risk equivalent amount relating to the non-modellable risk factor and the cause of the back-testing exceedance attributable to the non-modellable risk factor shall be recorded in a document and retained.

Where, as a result of back-testing for each trading desk, exceedances exceeding the number prescribed in the following items according to the category of confidence level listed in those items have occurred in the most recent twelve months, the market risk equivalent amount for that trading desk shall be calculated using the standardized method. (i) 97.5% confidence level: 30 times. (ii) 99% confidence level: 12 times.
An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall record in a document and retain the content and causes of exceedances in back-testing for each trading desk.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach may validate the internal model approach by back-testing based on a confidence level other than 99% or by other statistical methods.
